title: Prove the sharp cyclic-source dirty-root stock (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with finite exact corroboration: for the fixed binary source word `B0 ... B(n-1) B0 ... B(n-1)`, universal paired output readouts require exactly **n-1 arbitrary dirty roots for every n>=5**. The small minima are one root at n=1,2,3 and two roots at n=4.

```text
fixed repeated source order
  prefix differences = cyclic arcs
  feasible reader code contains ones
  rank-two quotient would require K2,2 inside a longer cycle
  therefore codimension <= 1
  a parity hyperplane attains n-1 roots
```

The upper program preserves every arbitrary dirty root, calls each source/output map twice, and charges `(2n-5)*2^n+4` root XORs. At n=5 its complete abstract incidence is four roots, 10 source calls, 62 readouts and 164 root XORs. The exact physical-port cost expression is in `research/cyclic-source-root-stock/PROOF.md`; no transfer-tariff optimum is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit [Arham Tahir / #2795](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2795) for the exact root-code criterion, [conorholds / #2182](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2182) for normalized axes and the differently ordered star, [Mason Hale / #2282](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2282) for mandatory-mask methods, Ross Richardson / #934/#943 for the dirty-prefix model, and Douglas Colkitt / #1185 and the retained connector lineage. Their main-tree source blobs are pinned as provenance. No predecessor implementation is imported or audited as the deliverable.

## Evidence

Before, the credited feasibility criterion reduced this source-order question to reader codes. After, one uniform proof classifies every feasible code at n>=5: precisely the full space and hyperplanes containing ones. It explains why repeating the same order can consume more root stock than the credited n-3-root star with a different source word.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on Darwin arm64 passes:

- All 3,290 codes containing ones at n=1..7, with exact dimension histograms and minima.
- All 85,818 surjective rank-two quotients killing ones at n=5..9. At n=5,6, each missing-mask witness is additionally checked against its entire kernel and difference set.
- Cyclic-arc identities and literal arbitrary-dirty forward/inverse programs at n=1..10; all 236 operation omissions at n=5 reject; nine invalid argument cases reject; the n=4 exception succeeds.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict registered checks, metadata/pins, seven-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, official committed export integrity, and optimized Git-free replay with empty PATH.
- Exported source corruption, receipt-count corruption and integer-to-float receipt corruption reject. All eight export files remain unchanged after the clean replay.

The generated RESULT.json binds six local source/metadata hashes. Each registered command took about 0.35 seconds locally, within its 180-second limit. These timings document replay feasibility, not a speedup.


## Limitations and unrun obligations

The fixed repeated source order, exactly two calls per source/output, generic binary linear maps, immutable sources, restored arbitrary dirt and scalar invertible root frames are essential. This is a scoped proof with finite corroboration, rather than a complete multiplication theorem. Physical caller placement, access/head-return implementation, hosting, precision/tape transfer, complete recursive profitability and supplier admission remain open. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No native, Lean, Docker or historical full scientific replay was needed or run. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. The selected conditional kappa remains 0.00302015. The card's prescribed original connector positive control passed. Entry overlap covered 411 open PRs and 3,919 Discussion records; sparse local-note omissions were supplemented by distinctive all-main README/proof and merged-term searches. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Open next questions

- Does one specified other double-permutation source order have a closed-form root minimum? Start with its exact difference set; the cyclic-arc obstruction does not automatically transfer.
- Does an actual recursive caller expose this order and benefit from reordering? Pin its chronology, stable ports and complete live-root/access/restoration ledger before claiming an adoption benefit.

## Related open work

No current open PR was found for this exact repeated-order root minimum. Nearby connector scopes are:

- #2134 studies a six-source one-TRIO source alphabet and paired coverage. This theorem permits only singleton source calls and changes root stock instead.
- #2249 prices higher-arity six-source events. It changes the source operation alphabet; this proof fixes the repeated singleton word.
- #3909 prices an arity-four five-source event. It studies dispatch/addition cost rather than the arbitrary-frame root minimum here.
- #3897 combines two output-map evaluations in one dispatch. This theorem retains separate output readouts and their full incidence.
- #1930 lets updated targets feed a persistent prefix chain. Targets here remain separate offline outputs and cannot feed back.
- #4834 determines signed two-source full-coefficient query cost over odd prime fields. This theorem uses binary masks, fixed order and variable root stock; no numerical comparison is made.

- #4899 optimizes weighted borrowed-source tours for pair-mask targets. It temporarily uses a source as its anchor and prices scalar ADD transitions, while this theorem preserves immutable sources and optimizes additional dirty-root stock for a fixed all-mask order.
- #4894 proves a high-weight excess bound for simple four-label length-ten prefix walks. This theorem fixes two repeated traversals, length eight at four labels, and computes root stock rather than excess.
- #4891 lower-bounds full-bank ADD scans for two dense chirp outputs. The endpoint, operation alphabet and measured quantity differ from this generic all-mask connector's root minimum; no numerical comparison is made.

The pre-DONE refresh read all 71 open PRs on this account, including ten created since the CLAIM and nine other submissions. None computes a competing root minimum for this repeated source order. The three nearby new scopes are recorded above. No additional predecessor computations were run, and no shared computed number disagrees.
